brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，用「规则」输入的改写规则把每个目标一直改下去，直到哪一条都对不上。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that rewrites each goal with the rules from the input Rules until none of them fits.

hint.zh: 和<level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref>一样，要改到改不动为止。
hint.en: As in <level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref>, the rewriting goes on until nothing fits.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref>也能接一串规则，用其中第一条对得上的。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref> can take a list of rules too, and uses the first that fits.

t.zh: 几条改写规则一起用，每次用对得上的那一条，改到哪一条都对不上为止，这叫化简。规则从板上的「规则」输入进来；设计出的证明助手会成为新元件，这个输入就是它的「规则」口。
t.en: Several rewrite rules used together, each time whichever fits, until none fits: this is simplification. The rules come in at the board’s input Rules; the proof assistant you design becomes a new part, , and that input becomes its port Rules.

after.zh: Isabelle 和 Lean 的 simp 做的也是这件事。
after.en: This is what simp does in Isabelle and Lean too.
